verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a REST API reference: the Search API page covers managing indices and records with authentication headers and retry guidance, and an api-reference page covers the official clients. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable request examples in the reference, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of the reference experience.
